name: Enesozer Guard for Core Web Vitals
author: enesozer

sections.description:
Enesozer Guard for Core Web Vitals provides a lightweight bootstrap for performance monitoring workflows.

This resubmission switches the review package to the proposed WordPress.org slug enesozer-guard-for-core-web-vitals and preserves a minimal public REST health endpoint for review:

  • GET /wp-json/para/v1/health
  • Safe direct-access guard via ABSPATH
  • WordPress 6.9 compatibility metadata
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip or copy the plugin folder into /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress admin.
  3. Confirm the health endpoint returns an ok status.
sections.faq:
What does the first review build include?

The current review build focuses on a clean bootstrap, health endpoint wiring, and packaging alignment for the updated WordPress.org review slug.
